checks.reason: This publication offers an independent policy possibility. No consumer repository was changed; candidate versions and conventions are not claimed to be migration-qualified.

limitations: The reference reads a deliberately literal declaration subset; it is not a complete GNU Make parser. Conditional reachability, includes, dynamic target expansion, recipe meaning and native suite coverage require real command execution at adoption.
The portable comparison inspects committed Makefile text without invoking repository setup or tests. It does not establish that the native frontend executes successfully.
The synthetic executable example uses host GNU Make and a POSIX shell; this does not qualify Windows environments.
Adding common role names does not itself enroll all-policy or make test complete; #16 and #17 own those checks.
The proposed dependency vocabulary may be supplied by the separate common uv environment policy. This reference does not choose a second resolver.
